mapper.sql: id, uuid, company_profile_id, template_id, risk_grade, matched_incidents_jsonb::text AS matched_incidents_jsonb, content_html, content_pdf_path, generated_at, accessed_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO safety_guideline_report (company_profile_id, template_id, risk_grade, matched_incidents_jsonb, content_html) VALUES (#{companyProfileId}, #{templateId}, #{riskGrade}, COALESCE(#{matchedIncidentsJsonb}, '[]')::jsonb, #{contentHtml})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM safety_guideline_report WHERE company_profile_id = #{companyProfileId}
SELECT FROM safety_guideline_report ORDER BY generated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE safety_guideline_report SET content_pdf_path = #{pdfPath} WHERE uuid = #{uuid}
UPDATE safety_guideline_report SET accessed_count = accessed_count + 1 WHERE uuid = #{uuid}
